exact_claim: Determine sharp A_n for every n>=2 over normalized holomorphic injective f on the open unit disk with f prime also injective, allowing complex coefficients.
primary_sources: https://arxiv.org/abs/1809.07200, printed pp. 114 and 135–136; full problem and update inspected
success_test: A proof identifying and attaining the sharp coefficient maxima for the whole class, with complete hypotheses and independent verification; partial bounds and special cases do not pass.
budget: Five substantive distinct approaches; modest exact algebra/interval controls; no exhaustive numerical search.
prior_attempt_gap: No matching repository attempt found in bounded live reads. Original selected upstream report unavailable; no claim of having audited its proof.
strongest_authored_results: Exact obstruction to conjugate averaging preserving derivative univalence.
Locally injective primitive with globally injective derivative but noninjective primitive.
Coefficient limit for explicitly defined reported candidate.
remaining_gap: Sharp A_2 and sharp all-n coefficients are unknown in this package; no extremal symmetry theorem; source candidate membership only reported, not reproved.
